description: Check text for plain language. Give `text`, optionally `targetGrade` (default 8) and `jargon` (your own words to flag). Returns Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade, rough reading age (grade plus 5), average sentence length, passive sentence count, sentences over 25 words, jargon and formal words with plain replacements (about 70 built in), wordy phrases ('in order to' -> 'to'), stacked negatives, and the worst sentences with reasons. English only; syllable counts are rule-based so grades are estimates.
name: plain_language_check
title: Plain language
